replies.author: @ChickadeeDesign
replies.text: @TravelBeyond4KI appreciate your positive vibe but this is in fact, not a good idea. Many countries have laws prohibiting this and depending on which country, penalties could be imposed on what seems like an innocent action to the casual observer. The reason for these laws to  exist is that bringing back seeds could potentially cause an ecological disaster. The American Chestnut is an example. Transporting plant materials can introduce bacteria, fungi, molds, blights and other diseases to native populations. Again, the positivity is great, just don’t want anyone to have to unnecessarily deal with a customs agent and face charges / fines.
